Thailand's Energy Regulatory Commission (ERC) issued draft Direct PPA regulations in Oct 2025, targeting data centers as initial
eligible buyers.
The pilot program is capped at 2,000 MW of renewable transactions, including solar, wind, hydropower, biopower and biogas.
Enables BOI-promoted data centers to contract directly with renewable energy producers via national grid under the new Third-
Party Access (TPA) Code.
Initially limited to data centers, the framework could expand to large corporates with sustainability and carbon-neutrality goals
in future phases.
DPPA model enables private contracting, moving beyond the single-buyer system and accelerating renewable energy access for
key industries.Outlook and Opportunities  Outlook and Opportunities
